segments.src: When a regional Federal Reserve Bank president steps down, the news rarely makes the front page.
segments.tr: 지역 연방준비은행 총재가 물러날 때, 그 뉴스가 1면을 장식하는 일은 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Yet the retirement of Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic puts a spotlight on one of the least understood parts of U.S.
segments.tr: 하지만 라파엘 보스틱 애틀랜타 연방준비은행 총재의 은퇴는 미국 통화 정책에서 가장 이해도가 낮은 부분 중 하나인

segments.tr: 금리 결정권자를 누가 뽑는지, 그리고 왜 그 과정이 시장에 중요한지에 대해 조명하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Bostic's Departure Means
segments.tr: ## 보스틱 총재의 사임이 의미하는 것

segments.src: Raphael Bostic announced he would retire from the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta after nearly two decades in public service and a tenure that began in 2017.
segments.tr: 라파엘 보스틱은 거의 20년에 걸친 공직 생활과 2017년부터 시작된 임기를 마치고 애틀랜타 연방준비은행에서 은퇴하겠다고 발표했습니다.

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: 그는 연방준비제도 역사상 최초의 흑인 총재였습니다.

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: 그의 퇴임으로 애틀랜타 연은의 최고위직은 워싱턴 기반의 연준 지도부 선출 방식과는 상당히 다른 과정을 통해 채워지게 됩니다.

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: 애틀랜타 연은은 앨라배마, 플로리다, 조지아, 그리고 루이지애나, 미시시피, 테네시 일부 지역을 관할합니다.

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: 이는 중앙은행의 사고방식에 직접적으로 반영되는 주택, 노동 시장, 비즈니스 상황에 대한 데이터를 제공하며, 빠르게 성장하는 이 지역을 들여다보는 귀중한 창구가 됩니다.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## 연준의 조직 구성

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: 연방준비제도는 두 개의 주요 계층으로 구성됩니다:

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **연방준비제도이사회(Board of Governors)**는 워싱턴 D.C.에 있으며 7명의 위원으로 구성됩니다. 각 위원은 미국 대통령이 지명하고 상원의 인준을 받으며 임기는 14년이고, 2년마다 한 명씩 교체되도록 엇갈려 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **12개의 지역 연방은행**은 애틀랜타, 보스턴, 시카고, 샌프란시스코 등을 포함하며, 각각 총재가 이끕니다.

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: 통화 정책 결정은 **연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)**에서 나옵니다.

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: 위원회는 12명의 투표권자로 구성되는데, 7명의 이사, 뉴욕 연은 총재, 그리고 1년 단위로 순번을 맡는 나머지 11명의 지역 연은 총재 중 4명입니다.

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: 12명의 지역 연은 총재 모두 회의에 참석하여 토론에 참여하지만, 해당 시점에 투표권을 가진 총재들만이 금리 결정에 투표합니다.

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## 지역 연은 총재 선출 방식

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: 이것이 이사회 위원과 지역 연은 총재 간의 핵심적인 차이점입니다.

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **지역 이사회가 주도합니다.** 각 연방은행에는 9명의 이사로 구성된 이사회가 있습니다. 그중 3명(C급 이사)은 연방준비제도이사회가 임명하고, 6명은 은행가와 비즈니스, 노동, 지역 사회 이익을 대변하는 일반인들로 구성되어 지역에서 선출됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **이사회가 후보를 지명합니다.** 은행가가 아닌 이사들이 총재를 선출하는 데 주도적인 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **워싱턴의 연방준비제도이사회가 승인해야 합니다.** 연방준비제도이사회가 서명하기 전까지는 임명이 확정되지 않습니다. 지역 연은 총재는 백악관이 지명하지 않으며 상원 인준도 필요하지 않습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **임기는 법령이 아닌 은행이 정합니다.** 총재의 임기는 5년이며, 시스템에는 이들의 정년퇴직에 관한 규칙이 있습니다.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: 이러한 설계는 의도적인 것입니다.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: 의회는 1913년, 결정이 워싱턴이나 월스트리트의 견해만을 반영하지 않도록 국가적 감독과 지역적 의견을 조화시키기 위해 이 시스템을 만들었습니다.

segments.src: ## Governors vs. Regional Presidents
segments.tr: ## 이사회 위원 vs 지역 연은 총재

segments.src: | | Board governors | Regional bank presidents |
segments.tr: | | 이사회 위원 | 지역 연은 총재 |

segments.src: | Selected by | President, confirmed by the Senate | Local board, approved by the Board of Governors |
segments.tr: | 선출 방식 | 대통령 지명, 상원 인준 | 지역 이사회 선출, 이사회 승인 |

segments.src: | Term | 14 years | 5 years |
| FOMC vote | Always | Only in certain years (New York always) |
segments.tr: | FOMC 투표 | 항상 | 특정 연도에만 (뉴욕은 항상) |

segments.src: | Political process | Public, high-profile | Mostly internal |
segments.tr: | 정치적 과정 | 공개적, 세간의 주목 | 대부분 내부적 |

segments.src: Because regional presidents come through a different route, they often bring different backgrounds: academic economists, former bank supervisors, or people with deep business roots.
segments.tr: 지역 연은 총재들은 다른 경로를 통해 선출되기 때문에 학계 경제학자, 전직 은행 감독관, 또는 비즈니스 분야에서 깊은 뿌리를 가진 사람들 등 다양한 배경을 가진 인물들이 임명되곤 합니다.

segments.src: They also have their own research staffs, which can produce independent economic analysis that sometimes diverges from the Washington consensus.
segments.tr: 또한 그들은 자체적인 연구진을 보유하고 있어, 때때로 워싱턴의 합의와는 다른 독자적인 경제 분석을 내놓기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## 왜 후임자 선정이 시장의 이야기가 되는가

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 연준의 금리 결정이 주택 담보 대출, 기업 차입 비용, 주식 가치 평가, 달러 가치에 영향을 미치기 때문에 연준을 주목합니다.

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: FOMC 테이블에 누가 앉느냐의 변화는 여러 면에서 중요할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **투표 균형.** 투표권을 가진 각 지역 연은 총재는 12명의 목소리 중 하나입니다. 분석가들은 종종 관료들을 "매파(인플레이션 억제에 더 집중)"와 "비둘기파(고용에 더 집중)"로 분류합니다. 새로운 총재는 전임자와 다른 성향을 보일 수 있지만, 단 한 표가 결과를 결정하는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **방향성에 대한 신호.** 연준 관계자들의 공개 연설과 서면 논평은 향후 정책에 대한 힌트를 얻기 위해 면밀히 읽힙니다. 새로운 총재의 첫 발언은 그들의 사고방식에 대한 단서를 찾기 위해 주목받습니다.

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **정치적 관심.** 최근 몇 년간 백악관은 금리에 대한 공개적인 언급부터 이사회 위원 임명 논쟁에 이르기까지 중앙은행의 방향에 이례적으로 강한 관심을 보여왔습니다. 이사회의 선출 과정에 대통령이 직접 관여하기 때문에, 지역 연은 총재 선출에 대한 이사회의 승인이 연방 정부의 유일한 역할임에도 불구하고, 자연스럽게 지역 연은 쪽으로도 관심이 확대되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **독립성 문제.** 연준은 단기적인 정치적 압력보다는 경제 데이터에 기반하여 결정을 내리도록 설계되었습니다. 공석이 생길 때마다 이러한 구조가 얼마나 잘 유지되는지에 대한 의문이 제기되며, 이것이 바로 선출 과정이 과거보다 더 많은 조사를 받는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음으로 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: - **Timing.** Searches for a regional president often take months. An interim leader, usually a first vice president, typically steps in while the search runs.
segments.tr: - **시기.** 지역 연은 총재를 찾는 데는 종종 몇 달이 걸립니다. 보통 수석 부총재가 임시 리더를 맡아 검색이 진행되는 동안 업무를 수행합니다.

segments.src: - **The candidate's profile.** Whether the board picks an academic, a veteran Fed staffer, or an outsider from business can hint at the bank's priorities.
segments.tr: - **후보자의 프로필.** 이사회가 학계 인사, 베테랑 연준 직원, 또는 비즈니스계의 외부 인사를 선택하는지는 해당 은행의 우선순위를 암시할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Approval by the Board of Governors.** This step is usually routine, but it is the one place where Washington has a formal say.
segments.tr: - **이사회 승인.** 이 단계는 보통 일상적인 절차이지만, 워싱턴이 공식적인 발언권을 갖는 유일한 곳입니다.

segments.src: - **The next FOMC meetings.** Look at how the committee's statements, projections, and any dissents evolve as personnel change.
segments.tr: - **다음 FOMC 회의.** 인사가 변경됨에 따라 위원회의 성명서, 전망, 그리고 반대 의견이 어떻게 변화하는지 지켜보십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Raphael Bostic's retirement is more than a personnel notice.
segments.tr: 라파엘 보스틱의 은퇴는 단순한 인사 공고 이상의 의미를 갖습니다.

segments.src: It is a reminder that the Fed is a layered institution, and that the people who shape U.S.
segments.tr: 이는 연준이 계층화된 기관이며, 미국 금리 정책을 형성하는 사람들이 여러 가지 독특한 경로를 통해 도착한다는 사실을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: interest-rate policy arrive by several distinct paths.
segments.tr: 지역 연은 총재가 어떻게 선출되는지, 그리고 그들이 이사회 위원과 어떻게 다른지 이해하는 것은 금리에 미치는 즉각적인 영향이 제한적이라 하더라도 왜 애틀랜타의 리더십 변화가 워싱턴에서 월스트리트까지 관심을 끌 수 있는지 설명하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: Understanding how regional presidents are chosen, and how they differ from governors, helps explain why a leadership change in Atlanta can attract attention from Washington to Wall Street, even if the immediate effect on rates is limited.
segments.tr: *이 기사의 정보는 공개적으로 이용 가능한 연방준비제도의 구조에 대한 설명을 반영합니다.

segments.src: When a regional Federal Reserve Bank president steps down, the news rarely makes the front page.
segments.tr: 当某一地方联邦储备银行主席卸任时，这类新闻很少登上头条新闻。

segments.src: Yet the retirement of Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic puts a spotlight on one of the least understood parts of U.S.
segments.tr: 然而，亚特兰大联储主席拉斐尔·博斯蒂克（Raphael Bostic）的退休，却让人们重新关注起美国货币政策中最不为人所了解的部分之一：

segments.src: monetary policy: who picks the people who help set interest rates, and why that process matters to markets.
segments.tr: 究竟是谁挑选了那些协助设定利率的人，以及这一过程为何对市场至关重要。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment advice.*
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成投资建议。*

segments.src: ## What Bostic's Departure Means
segments.tr: ## 博斯蒂克离任意味着什么

segments.src: Raphael Bostic announced he would retire from the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta after nearly two decades in public service and a tenure that began in 2017.
segments.tr: 拉斐尔·博斯蒂克宣布，在公共部门服务近二十年以及自 2017 年开始的任期之后，他将从亚特兰大联邦储备银行退休。

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: 他是联邦储备系统历史上的第一位非裔主席。

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: 他的离任留下了亚特兰大联储最高职位，这一空缺的填补过程与美联储华盛顿高层的选拔方式截然不同。

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: 亚特兰大联储管辖阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州、佐治亚州，以及路易斯安那州、密西西比州和田纳西州的部分地区。

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: 这使其成为观察该国快速增长区域的重要窗口，其有关住房、劳动力市场和商业状况的数据会直接纳入中央银行的决策考量。

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## 美联储的组织架构

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: 联邦储备系统有两个主要层级：

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **理事会（Board of Governors）**位于华盛顿特区，由七名成员组成。每名理事均由美国总统提名，并经参议院批准，任期 14 年，错开设置以使每两年出现一个空缺席位。

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **十二家地方储备银行**，包括亚特兰大、波士顿、芝加哥和旧金山等，每家均由一位主席领导。

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: 货币政策决定由**联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）**制定。

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: 它拥有十二名有表决权的成员：七名理事、纽约联储主席，以及其余十一家地方联储主席中的四位（后四位每年轮流行使表决权）。

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: 所有十二位地方联储主席均出席会议并参与讨论，但只有届时拥有表决权的人才能对利率决定投下赞成或反对票。

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## 地方联储主席如何选出

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: 这是理事与地方联储主席之间的关键区别。

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **当地董事会主持遴选。** 每家储备银行都有一个由九名董事组成的董事会。其中三名（称为 C 类董事）由理事会任命；六名由当地选出，混合了银行家以及代表商业、劳工和社区利益的公众成员。

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **董事提名候选人。** 非银行家董事在选拔主席方面发挥主导作用。

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **华盛顿理事会必须批准。** 任命在理事会批准前并非最终确定。地方联储主席不由白宫提名，也不需要参议院批准。

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **任期由联储规定，而非法定。** 主席任期为五年，系统内有关于其退休年龄的规定。

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: 这种设计是有意为之的。

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: 国会在 1913 年创建该系统，旨在将全国性监管与地方考量融为一体，从而使决策不会仅仅反映华盛顿或华尔街的观点。

segments.src: ## Governors vs. Regional Presidents
segments.tr: ## 理事 vs. 地方联储主席

segments.src: | | Board governors | Regional bank presidents |
segments.tr: | | 理事会理事 | 地方储备银行主席 |

segments.src: | Selected by | President, confirmed by the Senate | Local board, approved by the Board of Governors |
segments.tr: | 选拔方式 | 总统提名，参议院批准 | 当地董事会提名，理事会批准 |

segments.src: | Term | 14 years | 5 years |
| FOMC vote | Always | Only in certain years (New York always) |
segments.tr: | FOMC 表决权 | 始终拥有 | 仅在特定年份（纽约联储始终拥有） |

segments.src: | Political process | Public, high-profile | Mostly internal |
segments.tr: | 政治程序 | 公开、高调 | 主要是内部程序 |

segments.src: Because regional presidents come through a different route, they often bring different backgrounds: academic economists, former bank supervisors, or people with deep business roots.
segments.tr: 由于地方联储主席是通过不同途径选拔出来的，他们往往具备不同的背景：学术经济学家、前银行监管人员或具有深厚商业背景的人士。

segments.src: They also have their own research staffs, which can produce independent economic analysis that sometimes diverges from the Washington consensus.
segments.tr: 他们还拥有自己的研究团队，能够提供独立的经济分析，有时与华盛顿的共识有所分歧。

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## 为何继任人选会成为市场焦点

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: 投资者密切关注美联储，因为其利率选择会影响抵押贷款、企业借贷成本、股票估值以及美元汇率。

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: FOMC 会议桌旁席位的变动可能会在以下几个方面产生影响：

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **表决权平衡。** 每一位拥有表决权的地方联储主席都是十二个声音之一。分析师通常将官员归类为“鹰派”（更专注于控制通胀）和“鸽派”（更专注于促进就业）。新主席的倾向可能与其前任不同，尽管单张选票很少能决定最终结果。

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **政策走向信号。** 市场会密切研读美联储官员的公开演讲和书面言论，从中寻找未来政策的蛛丝马迹。新主席的首次表态会受到密切关注，以寻找其政策思路的线索。

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **政治关注。** 近年来，白宫对中央银行走向表现出不同寻常的强烈兴趣，从对利率的公开评论到对理事会成员任命的辩论。由于理事选拔程序直接涉及总统，关注度自然延伸到了地方联储这一边，尽管理事会的批准是中央政府在挑选地方联储主席过程中的唯一法定职责。

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **独立性疑问。** 美联储的设计旨在根据经济数据而非短期政治压力做出决定。任何职位空缺都会引发人们对该结构维持效果的疑问，这也是遴选过程比以往受到更多审查的原因之一。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来需要关注什么

segments.src: - **Timing.** Searches for a regional president often take months. An interim leader, usually a first vice president, typically steps in while the search runs.
segments.tr: - **时间安排。** 地方联储主席的遴选往往需要数月时间。在遴选进行期间，临时领导人（通常是第一副主席）通常会代理履职。

segments.src: - **The candidate's profile.** Whether the board picks an academic, a veteran Fed staffer, or an outsider from business can hint at the bank's priorities.
segments.tr: - **候选人履历。** 董事会是选择学术界人士、美联储资深员工还是来自商业界的外部人士，可以暗示出该联储的侧重点。

segments.src: - **Approval by the Board of Governors.** This step is usually routine, but it is the one place where Washington has a formal say.
segments.tr: - **理事会批准。** 这一步骤通常是例行公事，但这是华盛顿拥有正式发言权的唯一环节。

segments.src: - **The next FOMC meetings.** Look at how the committee's statements, projections, and any dissents evolve as personnel change.
segments.tr: - **接下来的 FOMC 会议。** 关注随着人事变动，委员会的声明、预测以及任何异议将如何演变。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Raphael Bostic's retirement is more than a personnel notice.
segments.tr: 拉斐尔·博斯蒂克的退休不仅仅是一则人事变动通知。

segments.src: It is a reminder that the Fed is a layered institution, and that the people who shape U.S.
segments.tr: 它提醒人们，美联储是一个具有多层架构的机构，塑造美国

segments.src: interest-rate policy arrive by several distinct paths.
segments.tr: 利率政策的人士是通过几种截然不同的途径履任的。

segments.src: Understanding how regional presidents are chosen, and how they differ from governors, helps explain why a leadership change in Atlanta can attract attention from Washington to Wall Street, even if the immediate effect on rates is limited.
segments.tr: 了解地方联储主席是如何选出的，以及他们与理事有何不同，有助于解释为何亚特兰大的领导层变动会引起从华盛顿到华尔街的关注，即使对利率的即时影响可能有限。

segments.src: When a regional Federal Reserve Bank president steps down, the news rarely makes the front page.

segments.src: ## What Bostic's Departure Means
segments.tr: ## बोस्टिक के जाने का क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Raphael Bostic announced he would retire from the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta after nearly two decades in public service and a tenure that began in 2017.
segments.tr: राफेल बोस्टिक ने घोषणा की कि वह सार्वजनिक सेवा में लगभग दो दशक और 2017 में शुरू हुए अपने कार्यकाल के बाद अटलांटा के फेडरल रिजर्व बैंक से सेवानिवृत्त हो जाएंगे।

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: वह फेडरल रिजर्व सिस्टम के इतिहास में पहले अश्वेत अध्यक्ष थे।

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: उनके जाने से अटलांटा फेड के शीर्ष पद को एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से भरा जाना है जो फेड के वाशिंगटन-आधारित नेताओं के चुने जाने के तरीके से काफी अलग है।

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: अटलांटा फेड अलबामा, फ्लोरिडा, जॉर्जिया और लुईसiana, मिसिसिपी तथा टेनेसी के कुछ हिस्सों को कवर करता है।

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: यह इसे देश के तेजी से बढ़ते हिस्से में एक मूल्यवान खिड़की बनाता है, जिसमें आवास, श्रम बाजारों और व्यावसायिक स्थितियों पर डेटा है जो सीधे केंद्रीय बैंक की सोच में योगदान देता है।

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## फेड कैसे संगठित है

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: फेडरल रिजर्व सिस्टम की दो मुख्य परतें हैं:

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स**, वाशिंगटन, डी.सी. में, सात सदस्य हैं। प्रत्येक को संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नामित किया जाता है और सीनेट द्वारा 14 साल के कार्यकाल के लिए पुष्टि की जाती है, जिसे इस तरह से क्रमबद्ध किया जाता है कि हर दो साल में एक सीट खाली हो जाती है।

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **बारह क्षेत्रीय रिजर्व बैंक**, जिनमें अटलांटा, बोस्टन, शिकागो और सैन फ्रांसिस्को शामिल हैं, प्रत्येक का नेतृत्व एक अध्यक्ष करता है।

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: मौद्रिक नीति के निर्णय **फेडरल ओपन मार्केट कमेटी (FOMC)** से आते हैं।

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: इसके बारह मतदान सदस्य हैं: सात गवर्नर, न्यूयॉर्क फेड के अध्यक्ष, और अन्य ग्यारह क्षेत्रीय राष्ट्रपतियों में से चार, जो घूर्णन वार्षिक आधार पर मतदान करते हैं।

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: सभी बारह क्षेत्रीय अध्यक्ष बैठकों में भाग लेते हैं और चर्चा में भाग लेते हैं, लेकिन उस समय वोट रखने वाले ही ब्याज दर के फैसले पर मतदान करते हैं।

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## क्षेत्रीय अध्यक्षों का चयन कैसे किया जाता है

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: यह गवर्नरों और क्षेत्रीय राष्ट्रपतियों के बीच मुख्य अंतर है।

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **एक स्थानीय निदेशक मंडल खोज का नेतृत्व करता है।** प्रत्येक रिजर्व बैंक के नौ निदेशकों का बोर्ड होता है। उनमें से तीन (जिन्हें क्लास सी निदेशक के रूप में जाना जाता है) बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स द्वारा नियुक्त किए जाते हैं; छह स्थानीय रूप से चुने जाते हैं, जिसमें व्यवसाय, श्रम और सामुदायिक हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले बैंकरों और जनता के सदस्यों का मिश्रण होता है।

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **निदेशक एक उम्मीदवार को नामित करते हैं।** गैर-बैंकर निदेशक अध्यक्ष का चयन करने में मुख्य भूमिका निभाते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **वाशिंगटन में बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स को मंजूरी देनी होगी।** नियुक्ति तब तक अंतिम नहीं होती जब तक बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स हस्ताक्षर नहीं कर देता। क्षेत्रीय राष्ट्रपतियों को व्हाइट हाउस द्वारा नामित नहीं किया जाता है और इसके लिए सीनेट की पुष्टि की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **कार्यकाल बैंक द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है, न कि कानून द्वारा।** राष्ट्रपतियों को पांच साल के कार्यकाल के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता है, और प्रणाली के पास उनके लिए सेवानिवृत्ति की आयु के बारे में नियम हैं।

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: यह डिजाइन जानबूझकर किया गया था।

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस ने 1913 में क्षेत्रीय इनपुट के साथ राष्ट्रीय oversight को मिश्रित करने के लिए प्रणाली बनाई, ताकि निर्णय केवल वाशिंगटन या वॉल स्ट्रीट के विचारों को प्रतिबिंबित न करें।

segments.src: ## Governors vs. Regional Presidents

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **मतदान संतुलन।** मतदान करने वाला प्रत्येक क्षेत्रीय अध्यक्ष बारह आवाजों में से एक है। विश्लेषक अक्सर अधिकारियों को "हॉक्स" (मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रित करने पर अधिक ध्यान केंद्रित) और "डव्स" (रोजगार पर अधिक ध्यान केंद्रित) में छांटते हैं। एक नया राष्ट्रपति पूर्ववर्ती से अलग झुक सकता है, हालांकि एक ही वोट शायद ही कभी परिणाम तय करता है।

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **दिशा के बारे में संकेत।** भविष्य की नीति पर संकेतों के लिए फेड अधिकारियों के सार्वजनिक भाषणों और लिखित टिप्पणी को बारीकी से पढ़ा जाता है। एक नए राष्ट्रपति की पहली टिप्पणियों को उनकी सोच के सुराग के लिए देखा जाता है।

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **राजनीतिक ध्यान।** हाल के वर्षों में, व्हाइट हाउस ने दरों के बारे में सार्वजनिक टिप्पणियों से लेकर बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स में नियुक्तियों पर बहस तक, केंद्रीय बैंक की दिशा में असामान्य रूप से मजबूत रुचि दिखाई है। चूंकि प्रक्रिया के गवर्नर्स की तरफ सीधे राष्ट्रपति शामिल होते हैं, इसलिए ध्यान स्वाभाविक रूप से क्षेत्रीय पक्ष तक भी बढ़ गया है, भले ही क्षेत्रीय राष्ट्रपति को चुनने में बोर्ड ऑफ गवर्नर्स की मंजूरी ही एकमात्र संघीय भूमिका हो।

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **स्वतंत्रता के प्रश्न।** फेड को अल्पकालिक राजनीतिक दबाव के बजाय आर्थिक डेटा के आधार पर निर्णय लेने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। कोई भी रिक्ति इस बारे में सवाल उठाती है कि वह ढांचा कितनी अच्छी तरह से टिकता है, यही एक कारण है कि चयन प्रक्रिया को एक बार की तुलना में अधिक जांच का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: - **The next FOMC meetings.** Look at how the committee's statements, projections, and any dissents evolve as personnel change.

es.title: Un asiento vacante en la Fed: Por qué importa la jubilación del presidente de la Fed de Atlanta, Bostic

segments.src: When a regional Federal Reserve Bank president steps down, the news rarely makes the front page.
segments.tr: Cuando el presidente de un Banco de la Reserva Federal regional deja el cargo, la noticia rara vez llega a la portada.

segments.src: Yet the retirement of Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic puts a spotlight on one of the least understood parts of U.S.

segments.src: monetary policy: who picks the people who help set interest rates, and why that process matters to markets.
segments.tr: monetaria de EE. UU.: quién elige a las personas que ayudan a fijar las tasas de interés y por qué ese proceso importa a los mercados.

segments.src: ## What Bostic's Departure Means
segments.tr: ## Qué significa la salida de Bostic

segments.src: Raphael Bostic announced he would retire from the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta after nearly two decades in public service and a tenure that began in 2017.
segments.tr: Raphael Bostic anunció que se jubilaría del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Atlanta después de casi dos décadas en el servicio público y un mandato que comenzó en 2017.

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: Fue el primer presidente negro en la historia del Sistema de la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: Su salida deja el puesto principal de la Fed de Atlanta para ser cubierto a través de un proceso que es bastante diferente de cómo se elige a los líderes de la Fed con sede en Washington.

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: La Fed de Atlanta cubre Alabama, Florida, Georgia y partes de Luisiana, Misisipi y Tennessee.

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: Eso la convierte en una ventana valiosa a una parte del país de rápido crecimiento, con datos sobre vivienda, mercados laborales y condiciones comerciales que alimentan directamente el pensamiento del banco central.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## Cómo está organizada la Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: El Sistema de la Reserva Federal tiene dos capas principales:

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **La Junta de Gobernadores** en Washington, D.C., tiene siete miembros. Cada uno es nombrado por el Presidente de los Estados Unidos y confirmado por el Senado para un mandato de 14 años, escalonado para que un asiento quede vacante cada dos años.

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **Doce Bancos de la Reserva regionales**, incluidos Atlanta, Boston, Chicago y San Francisco, cada uno liderado por un presidente.

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: Las decisiones de política monetaria provienen del **Comité Federal de Mercado Abierto (FOMC)**.

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: Tiene doce miembros con derecho a voto: los siete gobernadores, el presidente de la Fed de Nueva York y cuatro de los otros once presidentes regionales, que votan sobre una base anual rotativa.

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: Los doce presidentes regionales asisten a las reuniones y participan en la discusión, pero solo aquellos que poseen un voto en ese momento emiten boletas sobre la decisión de la tasa de interés.

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## Cómo se eligen los presidentes regionales

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: Esta es la diferencia clave entre los gobernadores y los presidentes regionales.

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **Una junta directiva local lidera la búsqueda.** Cada Banco de la Reserva tiene una junta de nueve directores. Tres de ellos (conocidos como directores de Clase C) son nombrados por la Junta de Gobernadores; seis son elegidos localmente, con una mezcla de banqueros y miembros del público que representan intereses comerciales, laborales y comunitarios.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **Los directores nominan a un candidato.** Los directores que no son banqueros desempeñan el papel principal en la selección de un presidente.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **La Junta de Gobernadores en Washington debe aprobar.** El nombramiento no es definitivo hasta que la Junta de Gobernadores lo apruebe. Los presidentes regionales no son nominados por la Casa Blanca y no requieren confirmación del Senado.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **Los mandatos son fijados por el banco, no por estatuto.** Los presidentes son nombrados por mandatos de cinco años, y el sistema tiene reglas sobre las edades de jubilación para ellos.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: El diseño fue intencional.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: El Congreso creó el sistema en 1913 para combinar la supervisión nacional con la aportación regional, de modo que las decisiones no reflejaran solo los puntos de vista de Washington o Wall Street.

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: Un cambio en quién se sienta alrededor de la mesa del FOMC puede importar de varias maneras:

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **Equilibrio de votación.** Cada presidente regional que vota es una de las doce voces. Los analistas a menudo clasifican a los funcionarios en "halcones" (más enfocados en controlar la inflación) y "palomas" (más enfocados en el empleo). Un nuevo presidente podría inclinarse de manera diferente al predecesor, aunque un solo voto rara vez decide un resultado.

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **Señales sobre la dirección.** Los discursos públicos y los comentarios escritos de los funcionarios de la Fed se leen atentamente en busca de pistas sobre la política futura. Los primeros comentarios de un nuevo presidente se observan en busca de pistas sobre su pensamiento.

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **Atención política.** En los últimos años, la Casa Blanca ha mostrado un interés inusualmente fuerte en la dirección del banco central, desde comentarios públicos sobre las tasas hasta debates sobre los nombramientos a la Junta de Gobernadores. Debido a que el lado del proceso de los gobernadores involucra directamente al Presidente, la atención se ha extendido naturalmente al lado regional también, aunque la aprobación de la Junta de Gobernadores es el único papel federal en la elección de un presidente regional.

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **Preguntas de independencia.** La Fed está diseñada para tomar decisiones basadas en datos económicos en lugar de presión política a corto plazo. Cualquier vacante invita a preguntas sobre qué tan bien se sostiene esa estructura, razón por la cual el proceso de selección atrae más escrutinio que antes.

segments.src: ## What Bostic's Departure Means
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني رحيل بوستيك

segments.src: Raphael Bostic announced he would retire from the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta after nearly two decades in public service and a tenure that began in 2017.
segments.tr: أعلن رفائيل بوستيك أنه سيعتزل العمل في بنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي في أتلانتا بعد ما يقرب من عقدين في الخدمة العامة وفترة ولاية بدأت في عام 2017.

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: وكان أول رئيس من أصل أفريقي في تاريخ نظام الاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: ويترك خروجه المنصب الأعلى في بنك أتلانتا الفيدرالي شاغراً ليتم شغله من خلال عملية تختلف تماماً عن كيفية اختيار قادة الفيدرالي المقيمين في واشنطن.

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: يغطي بنك أتلانتا الفيدرالي ولايات ألاباما، وفلوريدا، وجورجيا، وأجزاءً من لويزيانا، وميسيسيبي، وتينيسي.

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: وهذا ما يجعله نافذة قيمة على جزء سريع النمو من البلاد، مع توفير بيانات حول الإسكان، وأسواق العمل، وظروف الأعمال التي تغذي التفكير المركز للبنك المركزي بشكل مباشر.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## كيف يتم تنظيم الفيدرالي

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: يتكون نظام الاحتياطي الفيدرالي من مستويين رئيسيين:

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **مجلس المحافظين** في واشنطن العاصمة، ويضم سبعة أعضاء. يتم ترشيح كل منهم من قبل رئيس الولايات المتحدة ويصادق عليه مجلس الشيوخ لمدة 14 عاماً، وتكون الفترات متدرجة بحيث يصبح مقعد واحد شاغراً كل عامين.

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **إثنا عشر بنك احتياطي إقليمي**، بما في ذلك أتلانتا، وبوسطن، وشيكاغو، وسان فرانسيسكو، ويرأس كل منها رئيس.

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: تأتي قرارات السياسة النقدية من **اللجنة الفيدرالية للسوق المفتوحة (FOMC)**.

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: وتضم إثني عشر عضواً مِمَّن يحق لهم التصويت: المحافظون السبعة، ورئيس بنك نيويورك الفيدرالي، وأربعة من رؤساء البنوك الإقليمية الإحدى عشرة الأخرى، الذين يصوتون بالتناوب سنوياً.

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: يحضر جميع رؤساء البنوك الإقليمية الإثني عشر الاجتماعات ويشاركون في المناقشات، ولكن فقط أولئك الذين يمتلكون حق التصويت في ذلك الوقت هم من يدلون بأصواتهم على قرار سعر الفائدة.

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## كيف يتم اختيار الرؤساء الإقليميين

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: هذا هو الاختلاف الرئيسي بين المحافظين والرؤساء الإقليميين.

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **يقود مجلس إدارة محلي عملية البحث.** يمتلك كل بنك احتياطي مجلس إدارة مكوناً من تسعة أعضاء. يتم تعيين ثلاثة منهم (المعروفين بمديري الفئة C) من قبل مجلس المحافظين؛ ويتم اختيار ستة محلياً، بخليج من المصرفيين وأعضاء من الجمهور يمثلون مصالح الأعمال، والعمالة، والمجتمع.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **يرشح المدراء مرشحاً.** يلعب المدراء غير المصرفيين الدور الرئيسي في اختيار الرئيس.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **يجب على مجلس المحافظين في واشنطن الموافقة.** لا يصبح التعيين نهائياً حتى يوافق مجلس المحافظين. لا يتم ترشيح الرؤساء الإقليميين من قبل البيت الأبيض ولا يتطلب تعيينهم موافقة مجلس الشيوخ.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **تحدد البنوك مدد الولاية، وليس بموجب قانون.** يتم تعيين الرؤساء لولايات مدتها خمس سنوات، ولدى النظام قواعد بشأن أعمار التقاعد لهم.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: كان هذا التصميم مقصوداً.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: أنشأ الكونغرس النظام في عام 1913 لمزج الرقابة الوطنية مع المدخلات الإقليمية، بحيث لا تعكس القرارات آراء واشنطن أو وول ستريت فقط.

segments.src: ## Governors vs. Regional Presidents
segments.tr: ## المحافظون مقابل الرؤساء الإقليميين

segments.tr: | | محافظو المجلس | رؤساء البنوك الإقليمية |

segments.src: | Selected by | President, confirmed by the Senate | Local board, approved by the Board of Governors |
segments.tr: | جهة الاختيار | الرئيس، بموافقة مجلس الشيوخ | المجلس المحلي، بموافقة مجلس المحافظين |

segments.src: | Term | 14 years | 5 years |
segments.tr: | مدة الولاية | 14 عاماً | 5 سنوات |

segments.tr: | تصويت FOMC | دائماً | في سنوات معينة فقط (نيويورك دائماً) |

segments.src: | Political process | Public, high-profile | Mostly internal |
segments.tr: | العملية السياسية | علنية، بارزة الإعلام | داخلية غالباً |

segments.src: Because regional presidents come through a different route, they often bring different backgrounds: academic economists, former bank supervisors, or people with deep business roots.
segments.tr: لأن الرؤساء الإقليميين يأتون عبر مسار مختلف، فإنهم غالباً ما يجلبون خلفيات متنوعة: اقتصاديون أكاديميون، أو مشرفو بنوك سابقون، أو أشخاص ذوو جذور عميقة في مجال الأعمال.

segments.src: They also have their own research staffs, which can produce independent economic analysis that sometimes diverges from the Washington consensus.
segments.tr: كما يمتلكون طواقم بحث خاصة بهم، والتي يمكنها إنتاج تحليلات اقتصادية مستقلة تتباعد أحياناً عن إجماع واشنطن.

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## لماذا تصبح خلافة المناصب قصة تهم الأسواق

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: يولي المستثمرون اهتماماً بالفيدرالي لأن خياراته بشأن أسعار الفائدة تؤثر على الرهون العقارية، وتكاليف اقتراض الشركات، وتقييمات الأسهم، وقيمة الدولار.

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: ويمكن للتغيير فيمن يجلس حول طاولة FOMC أن يحدث فرقاً بعدة طرق:

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **توازن التصويت.** كل رئيس إقليمي يصوت هو واحد من إثني عشر صوتاً. غالباً ما يصنف المحللون المسؤولين إلى "صقور" (أكثر تركيزاً على السيطرة على التضخم) و"حمائم" (أكثر تركيزاً على التوظيف). يمكن للرئيس الجديد أن يميل بشكل مختلف عن سلفه، على الرغم من أن الصوت الواحد نادراً ما يحسم النتيجة.

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **إشارات حول الاتجاه.** تُقرأ الخطابات العامة والتعليقات المكتوبة لمسؤولي الفيدرالي بعناية للحصول على تلميحات حول السياسة المستقبلية. وتتم مراقبة الملاحظات الأولى للرئيس الجديد للحصول على أدلة حول تفكيره.

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **الاهتمام السياسي.** في السنوات الأخيرة، أبدى البيت الأبيض اهتماماً قوياً وغير عادي باتجاه البنك المركزي، بدءاً من التعليقات العامة حول الفائدة وصولاً إلى المناقشات حول التعيينات في مجلس المحافظين. ولأن جانب المحافظين في العملية يشمل الرئيس مباشرة، فقد امتد الاهتمام طبيعياً إلى الجانب الإقليمي أيضاً، رغم أن موافقة مجلس المحافظين هي الدور الفيدرالي الوحيد في اختيار رئيس إقليمي.

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **أسئلة الاستقلالية.** تم تصميم الفيدرالي لاتخاذ القرارات بناءً على البيانات الاقتصادية بدلاً من الضغوط السياسية قصيرة المدى. وتثير أي وظيفة شاغرة أسئلة حول مدى تماسك هذا الهيكل، وهو أحد الأسباب التي تجعل عملية الاختيار تجتذب تدقيقاً أكثر مما كانت عليه من قبل.

segments.tr: - **Le Conseil des gouverneurs** à Washington, D.C., compte sept membres. Chacun est nommé par le président des États-Unis et confirmé par le Sénat pour un mandat de 14 ans, échelonné de manière à ce qu'un siège se libère tous les deux ans.

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **Douze banques régionales de la Réserve**, dont celles d'Atlanta, Boston, Chicago et San Francisco, dirigées chacune par un président.

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: Les décisions de politique monétaire émanent du **Comité fédéral de l'open market (FOMC)**.

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: Il compte douze membres votants : les sept gouverneurs, le président de la Fed de New York et quatre des onze autres présidents régionaux, qui votent selon une rotation annuelle.

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: Tous les douze présidents régionaux assistent aux réunions et participent aux discussions, mais seuls ceux qui détiennent un droit de vote à ce moment-là prennent part au vote sur la décision relative aux taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## Comment sont choisis les présidents régionaux

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: C'est la différence clé entre les gouverneurs et les présidents régionaux.

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **Un conseil d'administration local dirige la recherche.** Chaque banque de la Réserve possède un conseil de neuf administrateurs. Trois d'entre eux (connus sous le nom d'administrateurs de classe C) sont nommés par le Conseil des gouverneurs ; six sont choisis localement, avec un mélange de banquiers et de membres du public représentant les intérêts des entreprises, du travail et de la communauté.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **Les administrateurs nomment un candidat.** Les administrateurs qui ne sont pas des banquiers jouent un rôle prépondérant dans la sélection d'un président.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **Le Conseil des gouverneurs à Washington doit approuver.** La nomination n'est définitive que lorsque le Conseil des gouverneurs donne son accord. Les présidents régionaux ne sont pas nommés par la Maison-Blanche et ne nécessitent pas la confirmation du Sénat.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **Les mandats sont fixés par la banque, et non par la loi.** Les présidents sont nommés pour des mandats de cinq ans, et le système comporte des règles concernant leur âge de départ à la retraite.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: Cette conception était intentionnelle.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: Le Congrès a créé le système en 1913 pour allier la supervision nationale et la contribution régionale, afin que les décisions ne reflètent pas seulement les points de vue de Washington ou de Wall Street.

segments.src: They also have their own research staffs, which can produce independent economic analysis that sometimes diverges from the Washington consensus.
segments.tr: Ils disposent également de leurs propres équipes de recherche, qui peuvent produire des analyses économiques indépendantes divergeant parfois du consensus de Washington.

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la succession devient un sujet de marché

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs prêtent attention à la Fed parce que ses choix en matière de taux d'intérêt influencent les prêts hypothécaires, les coûts d'emprunt des entreprises, la valorisation des actions et la valeur du dollar.

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: Un changement parmi les personnes qui siègent à la table du FOMC peut avoir de l'importance de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **Équilibre des votes.** Chaque président régional qui vote est l'une des douze voix. Les analystes classent souvent les responsables en « faucons » (plus axés sur la maîtrise de l'inflation) et « colombes » (plus axés sur l'emploi). Un nouveau président pourrait avoir des orientations différentes de son prédécesseur, bien qu'un seul vote décide rarement d'un résultat.

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **Signaux sur l'orientation.** Les discours publics et les commentaires écrits des responsables de la Fed sont lus attentivement pour y déceler des indices sur la politique future. Les premières remarques d'un nouveau président sont surveillées pour comprendre sa réflexion.

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **Attention politique.** Ces dernières années, la Maison-Blanche a manifesté un intérêt inhabituellement fort pour l'orientation de la banque centrale, allant de commentaires publics sur les taux à des débats sur les nominations au Conseil des gouverneurs. Comme le volet du processus concernant les gouverneurs implique directement le Président, l'attention s'est naturellement étendue au volet régional, même si l'approbation du Conseil des gouverneurs est le seul rôle fédéral dans le choix d'un président régional.

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **Questions d'indépendance.** La Fed est conçue pour prendre des décisions fondées sur des données économiques plutôt que sur des pressions politiques à court terme. Toute vacance suscite des interrogations sur la solidité de cette structure, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi le processus de sélection fait l'objet d'un examen plus minutieux qu'auparavant.

segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: - **Timing.** Searches for a regional president often take months. An interim leader, usually a first vice president, typically steps in while the search runs.
segments.tr: - **Calendrier.** La recherche d'un président régional prend souvent des mois. Un dirigeant intérimaire, généralement un premier vice-président, prend généralement le relais pendant que la recherche est en cours.

segments.tr: - **Le profil du candidat.** Que le conseil choisisse un universitaire, un vétéran du personnel de la Fed ou une personne extérieure issue du monde des affaires, cela peut donner des indications sur les priorités de la banque.

segments.src: - **Approval by the Board of Governors.** This step is usually routine, but it is the one place where Washington has a formal say.
segments.tr: - **Approbation par le Conseil des gouverneurs.** Cette étape est généralement routinière, mais c'est le seul endroit où Washington a un droit de regard officiel.

segments.tr: Raphael Bostic mengumumkan bahwa ia akan pensiun dari Bank Cadangan Federal Atlanta setelah hampir dua dekade mengabdi pada publik dan masa jabatan yang dimulai pada tahun 2017.

segments.src: He was the first Black president in the history of the Federal Reserve System.
segments.tr: Ia adalah presiden kulit hitam pertama dalam sejarah Sistem Cadangan Federal.

segments.src: His exit leaves the Atlanta Fed's top job to be filled through a process that is quite different from how the Fed's Washington-based leaders are chosen.
segments.tr: Kepergiannya menyisakan posisi puncak Fed Atlanta untuk diisi melalui proses yang sangat berbeda dari cara pemilihan pemimpin Fed yang berbasis di Washington.

segments.src: The Atlanta Fed covers Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee.
segments.tr: Fed Atlanta mencakup Alabama, Florida, Georgia, serta sebagian Louisiana, Mississippi, dan Tennessee.

segments.src: That makes it a valuable window into a fast-growing part of the country, with data on housing, labor markets, and business conditions that feed directly into the central bank's thinking.
segments.tr: Hal itu menjadikannya jendela yang berharga ke bagian negara yang berkembang pesat, dengan data tentang perumahan, pasar tenaga kerja, dan kondisi bisnis yang langsung memengaruhi pemikiran bank sentral.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Fed Dihimpun

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: Sistem Cadangan Federal memiliki dua lapisan utama:

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **Dewan Gubernur** di Washington, D.C., memiliki tujuh anggota. Masing-masing dicalonkan oleh Presiden Amerika Serikat dan dikonfirmasi oleh Senat untuk masa jabatan 14 tahun, yang diatur secara bertahap sehingga satu kursi kosong setiap dua tahun.

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **Dua belas Bank Cadangan regional**, termasuk Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, dan San Francisco, masing-masing dipimpin oleh seorang presiden.

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: Keputusan kebijakan moneter berasal dari **Komite Pasar Terbuka Federal (FOMC)**.

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: Komite ini memiliki dua belas anggota pemberi suara: tujuh gubernur, presiden Fed New York, dan empat dari sebelas presiden regional lainnya, yang memberikan suara secara bergiliran setiap tahun.

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: Kedua belas presiden regional menghadiri pertemuan dan mengambil bagian dalam diskusi, tetapi hanya mereka yang memegang hak suara pada saat itu yang memberikan suara pada keputusan suku bunga.

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Presiden Regional Dipilih

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: Ini adalah perbedaan utama antara gubernur dan presiden regional.

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **Dewan direksi lokal memimpin pencarian.** Setiap Bank Cadangan memiliki dewan yang terdiri dari sembilan direktur. Tiga dari mereka (dikenal sebagai direktur Kelas C) ditunjuk oleh Dewan Gubernur; enam dipilih secara lokal, dengan campuran bankir dan anggota masyarakat yang mewakili kepentingan bisnis, tenaga kerja, dan komunitas.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **Para direktur mencalonkan seorang kandidat.** Para direktur non-bankir memainkan peran utama dalam memilih presiden.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **Dewan Gubernur di Washington harus menyetujui.** Penunjukan tersebut tidak bersifat final sampai Dewan Gubernur menandatanganinya. Presiden regional tidak dicalonkan oleh Gedung Putih dan tidak memerlukan konfirmasi Senat.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **Masa jabatan ditetapkan oleh bank, bukan oleh undang-undang.** Presiden ditunjuk untuk masa jabatan lima tahun, dan sistem tersebut memiliki aturan tentang usia pensiun bagi mereka.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: Desain ini dibuat dengan sengaja.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: Kongres menciptakan sistem ini pada tahun 1913 untuk memadukan pengawasan nasional dengan masukan regional, sehingga keputusan tidak hanya mencerminkan pandangan Washington atau Wall Street.

segments.src: ## Governors vs. Regional Presidents
segments.tr: ## Gubernur vs. Presiden Regional

segments.src: | | Board governors | Regional bank presidents |
segments.tr: | | Gubernur Dewan | Presiden bank regional |

segments.src: | Selected by | President, confirmed by the Senate | Local board, approved by the Board of Governors |
segments.tr: | Dipilih oleh | Presiden, dikonfirmasi oleh Senat | Dewan lokal, disetujui oleh Dewan Gubernur |

segments.src: | Term | 14 years | 5 years |
segments.tr: | Masa jabatan | 14 tahun | 5 tahun |

segments.src: | FOMC vote | Always | Only in certain years (New York always) |
segments.tr: | Suara FOMC | Selalu | Hanya pada tahun-tahun tertentu (New York selalu) |

segments.src: | Political process | Public, high-profile | Mostly internal |
segments.tr: | Proses politik | Publik, profil tinggi | Sebagian besar internal |

segments.src: Because regional presidents come through a different route, they often bring different backgrounds: academic economists, former bank supervisors, or people with deep business roots.
segments.tr: Karena presiden regional melalui jalur yang berbeda, mereka sering kali membawa latar belakang yang berbeda: ekonom akademis, mantan pengawas bank, atau orang-orang dengan akar bisnis yang kuat.

segments.src: They also have their own research staffs, which can produce independent economic analysis that sometimes diverges from the Washington consensus.
segments.tr: Mereka juga memiliki staf riset sendiri, yang dapat menghasilkan analisis ekonomi independen yang terkadang berbeda dari konsensus Washington.

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Suksesi Menjadi Cerita Pasar

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: Investor memperhatikan Fed karena pilihannya mengenai suku bunga memengaruhi hipotek, biaya pinjaman perusahaan, valuasi saham, dan nilai dolar.

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: Perubahan pada siapa yang duduk di meja FOMC dapat berdampak dalam beberapa hal:

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **Keseimbangan suara.** Setiap presiden regional yang memberikan suara adalah salah satu dari dua belas suara. Analis sering kali menggolungkan pejabat ke dalam "kubu hawkish" (lebih fokus pada pengendalian inflasi) dan "kubu dovish" (lebih fokus pada ketenagakerjaan). Presiden baru bisa memiliki pandangan yang berbeda dari pendahulunya, meskipun satu suara jarang memutuskan hasil.

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **Sinyal tentang arah.** Pidato publik dan komentar tertulis dari pejabat Fed dibaca secara cermat untuk mendapatkan petunjuk tentang kebijakan masa depan. Pernyataan pertama seorang presiden baru diamati untuk mencari petunjuk tentang pemikiran mereka.

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. Because the governors' side of the process involves the President directly, attention has naturally extended to the regional side as well, even though the Board of Governors' approval is the only federal role in picking a regional president.
segments.tr: - **Perhatian politik.** Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Gedung Putih telah menunjukkan minat yang sangat kuat terhadap arah bank sentral, mulai dari komentar publik tentang suku bunga hingga perdebatan mengenai penunjukan ke Dewan Gubernur. Karena sisi proses gubernur melibatkan Presiden secara langsung, perhatian secara alami meluas ke sisi regional juga, meskipun persetujuan Dewan Gubernur adalah satu-satunya peran federal dalam memilih presiden regional.

segments.src: - **Independence questions.** The Fed is designed to make decisions based on economic data rather than short-term political pressure. Any vacancy invites questions about how well that structure holds up, which is one reason the selection process draws more scrutiny than it once did.
segments.tr: - **Pertanyaan independensi.** Fed dirancang untuk membuat keputusan berdasarkan data ekonomi daripada tekanan politik jangka pendek. Setiap kekosongan mengundang pertanyaan tentang seberapa baik struktur tersebut bertahan, yang merupakan salah satu alasan mengapa proses seleksi menarik lebih banyak pengawasan daripada sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: - **Timing.** Searches for a regional president often take months. An interim leader, usually a first vice president, typically steps in while the search runs.
segments.tr: - **Waktu.** Pencarian presiden regional sering kali memakan waktu berbulan-bulan. Seorang pemimpin sementara, biasanya wakil presiden pertama, biasanya turun tangan selama pencarian berlangsung.

segments.src: - **The candidate's profile.** Whether the board picks an academic, a veteran Fed staffer, or an outsider from business can hint at the bank's priorities.
segments.tr: - **Profil kandidat.** Apakah dewan memilih seorang akademisi, staf senior Fed, atau orang luar dari dunia bisnis dapat memberi petunjuk tentang prioritas bank.

segments.src: - **Approval by the Board of Governors.** This step is usually routine, but it is the one place where Washington has a formal say.
segments.tr: - **Persetujuan oleh Dewan Gubernur.** Langkah ini biasanya rutin, tetapi ini adalah satu tempat di mana Washington memiliki suara formal.

segments.src: - **The next FOMC meetings.** Look at how the committee's statements, projections, and any dissents evolve as personnel change.
segments.tr: - **Pertemuan FOMC berikutnya.** Perhatikan bagaimana pernyataan, proyeksi, and perbedaan pendapat komite berkembang seiring perubahan personel.

segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Raphael Bostic's retirement is more than a personnel notice.
segments.tr: Pensiunnya Raphael Bostic lebih dari sekadar pemberitahuan personel.

segments.src: It is a reminder that the Fed is a layered institution, and that the people who shape U.S.
segments.tr: Ini adalah pengingat bahwa Fed adalah lembaga berlapis, dan bahwa orang-orang yang membentuk kebijakan suku bunga AS tiba melalui beberapa jalur yang berbeda.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Is Organized
segments.tr: ## FRBの組織構造

segments.src: The Federal Reserve System has two main layers:
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度には主に2つの階層がある。

segments.src: - **The Board of Governors** in Washington, D.C., has seven members. Each is nominated by the President of the United States and confirmed by the Senate to a 14-year term, staggered so that one seat comes open every two years.
segments.tr: - **理事会（Board of Governors）**：ワシントンD.C.にあり、7人のメンバーで構成される。各メンバーは米国大統領が指名し、上院の承認を経て14年の任期を務める。2年ごとに1つの空席が出るよう任期がずらされている。

segments.src: - **Twelve regional Reserve Banks**, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, and San Francisco, each led by a president.
segments.tr: - **12の地区連邦準備銀行**：アトランタ、ボストン、シカゴ、サンフランシスコなどを含み、それぞれ総裁が率いる。

segments.src: Monetary policy decisions come from the **Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)**.
segments.tr: 金融政策の決定は**連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）**によって行われる。

segments.src: It has twelve voting members: the seven governors, the president of the New York Fed, and four of the other eleven regional presidents, who vote on a rotating annual basis.
segments.tr: 投票権を持つメンバーは12人で、7人の理事、ニューヨーク連銀総裁、そして残りの11の地区連銀総裁の中から持ち回りで選ばれる4人である。

segments.src: All twelve regional presidents attend meetings and take part in the discussion, but only those holding a vote at that time cast ballots on the interest-rate decision.
segments.tr: 12人の地区連銀総裁全員が会議に出席し議論に参加するが、その時点で投票権を持つ者だけが金利決定の投票を行う。

segments.src: ## How Regional Presidents Are Chosen
segments.tr: ## 地区連銀総裁の選出方法

segments.src: This is the key difference between governors and regional presidents.
segments.tr: これが理事と地区連銀総裁の決定的な違いである。

segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **地元の取締役会が選考を主導する。** 各連銀には9人の取締役からなる取締役会がある。そのうち3人（C種取締役と呼ばれる）は理事会が任命し、6人は地元の銀行家やビジネス、労働、地域社会の利益を代表する一般からのメンバーが混ざり合って選出される。

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **取締役会が候補者を指名する。** 銀行家以外の取締役が総裁選出において主導的な役割を果たす。

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **ワシントンの理事会による承認が必要である。** 理事会が承認するまで任命は正式に確定しない。地区連銀総裁はホワイトハウスによって指名されることはなく、上院の承認も必要ない。

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **任期は法律ではなく銀行によって定められる。** 総裁は5年の任期で任命され、制度には退職年齢に関する規定がある。

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: この設計には意図があった。

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: 議会は1913年に、国家的な監督と地域の意見を融合させ、決定がワシントンやウォール街の意見だけに偏らないようにするためにこの制度を作った。

segments.src: ## Why Succession Becomes a Market Story
segments.tr: ## なぜ後継者選びが市場の話題になるのか

segments.src: Investors pay attention to the Fed because its choices on interest rates influence mortgages, corporate borrowing costs, stock valuations, and the value of the dollar.
segments.tr: 投資家がFRBに注目するのは、金利に関する決定が住宅ローン、企業の借入コスト、株価評価、そしてドルの価値に影響を与えるからである。

segments.src: A change in who sits around the FOMC table can matter in several ways:
segments.tr: FOMCのテーブルを囲むメンバーの交代は、いくつかの面で重要となる。

segments.src: - **Voting balance.** Each regional president who votes is one of twelve voices. Analysts often sort officials into "hawks" (more focused on controlling inflation) and "doves" (more focused on employment). A new president could lean differently from the predecessor, although a single vote rarely decides an outcome.
segments.tr: - **投票のバランス。** 投票権を持つ各地区連銀総裁は12票のうちの1票を持つ。アナリストはしばしば当局者を「タカ派」（インフレ抑制をより重視）と「ハト派」（雇用をより重視）に分類する。新任の総裁は前任者とは異なるスタンスを取る可能性があるが、1票だけで結果が決まることはめったにない。

segments.src: - **Signals about direction.** Public speeches and written commentary from Fed officials are closely read for hints on future policy. A new president's first remarks are watched for clues about their thinking.
segments.tr: - **政策方向性へのシグナル。** FRB当局者の公開演説や書面によるコメントは、将来の政策のヒントを得るために細かく読み解かれる。新任総裁の最初の発言には、その考え方の手がかりがないか注目が集まる。

segments.src: - **Political attention.** In recent years, the White House has shown unusually strong interest in the direction of the central bank, from public comments about rates to debates over appointments to the Board of Governors. segments.src: 1. **A local board of directors leads the search.** Each Reserve Bank has a board of nine directors. Three of them (known as Class C directors) are appointed by the Board of Governors; six are chosen locally, with a mix of bankers and members of the public representing business, labor, and community interests.
segments.tr: 1. **Hội đồng quản trị địa phương dẫn đầu việc tìm kiếm.** Mỗi Ngân hàng Dự trữ có một hội đồng gồm chín giám đốc. Ba trong số họ (được gọi là giám đốc Hạng C) được bổ nhiệm bởi Hội đồng Thống đốc; sáu người được chọn tại địa phương, bao gồm sự kết hợp giữa các chủ ngân hàng và các thành viên công chúng đại diện cho lợi ích kinh doanh, lao động và cộng đồng.

segments.src: 2. **The directors nominate a candidate.** The non-banker directors play the leading role in selecting a president.
segments.tr: 2. **Các giám đốc đề cử ứng viên.** Các giám đốc không phải là chủ ngân hàng đóng vai trò hàng đầu trong việc lựa chọn chủ tịch.

segments.src: 3. **The Board of Governors in Washington must approve.** The appointment is not final until the Board of Governors signs off. Regional presidents are not nominated by the White House and do not require Senate confirmation.
segments.tr: 3. **Hội đồng Thống đốc tại Washington phải phê chuẩn.** Việc bổ nhiệm chưa phải là cuối cùng cho đến khi Hội đồng Thống đốc ký duyệt. Chủ tịch khu vực không được đề cử bởi Nhà Trắng và không cần Thượng viện phê chuẩn.

segments.src: 4. **Terms are set by the bank, not by statute.** Presidents are appointed for five-year terms, and the system has rules about retirement ages for them.
segments.tr: 4. **Nhiệm kỳ do ngân hàng quy định, không phải theo luật định.** Các chủ tịch được bổ nhiệm với nhiệm kỳ năm năm, và hệ thống có các quy định về độ tuổi nghỉ hưu đối với họ.

segments.src: The design was intentional.
segments.tr: Thiết kế này là có chủ ý.

segments.src: Congress created the system in 1913 to blend national oversight with regional input, so that decisions would not reflect only the views of Washington or Wall Street.
segments.tr: Quốc hội đã tạo ra hệ thống này vào năm 1913 để kết hợp sự giám sát quốc gia với đóng góp của khu vực, sao cho các quyết định không chỉ phản ánh quan điểm của Washington hay Phố Wall.
